title.zh: 租金管制（豁免——丹戎巴葛）公告
title.en: Control of Rent (Exemption — Tanjong Pagar) Notification

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Control of Rent (Exemption — Tanjong Pagar) Notification.

2. All the premises within the area bounded by Tanjong Pagar Road, Cook Street, into the backlane, along Murray Street, meeting Tanjong Pagar Road, into Neil Road, along the North-eastern boundary and South-eastern boundary of Lot 70 TS 5, across Craig Road, into the Southern boundary of Lot 61-1 TS 23, along the backlane and the Eastern boundary of Lot 207-9 TS 23, meeting the North-eastern boundary of Lot 724 TS 23, into Craig Road and more particularly delineated on the plan set out in the Schedule, are exempted from the provisions of the Act.
